candidates.change_summary: Replace the final statement 'return true;' with 'return false;', so a successful transfer call now returns false instead of true.
Delete the require(_s) check so failed external transferFrom calls no longer revert the transaction.
Replace msg.sender with address(this) as the from account in the external transferFrom call.
Replace the transferFrom selector with the transfer(address,uint256) selector, changing the external call signature.
Delete the zero-address check so transfer can be invoked with contract_address = address(0), where the low-level call succeeds trivially.
Delete the self-address check so transfer can be invoked with contract_address = address(this), which succeeds via a self low-level call instead of reverting.
